intent.goal: Show, as a picture, why 1 + 3 + 5 + ... + (2n - 1) = n².
intent.audience: Ages 12 and up; anyone who likes a proof you can see.
intent.takeaway: Each odd number is an L-shaped strip that grows a square by one.
intent.hook: Add odd numbers and you only ever get perfect squares.

science.topic: sum of odd numbers; proof without words
science.model: exact integer arithmetic; identity proved symbolically
caveats: The picture shows n = 5; the identity fact covers every positive integer n.

sfx: soft click as each square lands

timeline.visual: Title and the sum as a question over an empty grid area.
Five L-shaped strips land one after another, each a new colour, growing a square. A line under the grid keeps the running sum.

timeline.purpose: State the rule and that it was checked.
timeline.visual: The finished 5 by 5 square stays; the card shows the general formula.

c1_heading.text: Each odd number wraps the square in one more L

c1_note.text: The corner of each L shows how many squares it adds.

c2_note.text: Proved for every n, and added up directly for each n up to 1 000.
